The '''Tetan Guard airspeeder''' was a model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used by the [[Tetan Guard]]. Manufactured by [[Kodoos Repulsor Ltd.]], the airspeeder was crafted for the Guard as a patrol and defense vehicle. The semi-open cockpit design featured two externally sealed prisoner pods, a loudspeaker, and encrypted comms.<ref name="NoP" />
